story_text:
## Your Power Armory.
One Station. All Your Everyday Devices.
Bring laptop, tablet, phone and accessory charging together in one desktop station. Give the devices you use every day a shared place to recharge. With USB-C, USB-A and a magnetic watch charging spot brought into one upright unit, you can plan your connections around your workspace instead of finding room for another charging brick.
## Power Your Entire Desk
10 USB ports. High-power charging. A dedicated place on your desk. From the laptop you work on to the phone you reach for between tasks, keep your charging connections in one visible place. A front-facing port layout makes it easy to see where each cable belongs, while the upright design gives the station a defined place in your setup.
## 660W Power. One Station.
Bring 660W of total output to your desktop. Six USB-C ports, four USB-A ports and a magnetic Apple Watch charging spot bring laptops, tablets, phones and everyday accessories together in one powerful charging station.
## Plug In. Connect. Charge.
Connect the station to power, then plug in your compatible laptop, phone and tablet. There is no need to build your setup around a row of separate adapters. Start with the device in front of you, add the others you need, and check their charging indicators as you connect them.
## Your Devices, Charging Together.
Keep your laptop, tablet, phone and everyday accessories charging together, so you can move from work to play without juggling separate chargers.
## One Setup. Multiple Devices.
From laptops and gaming handhelds to phones and earbuds, give your everyday devices one shared place to recharge.
## 10 Ports. One Place to Plug In.
Six USB-C ports and four USB-A ports bring your charging connections together. Clearly labeled ports make it easy to choose the right connection for each device.
## Two Connection Types. Everyday Flexibility.
Connect compatible USB-C and USB-A charging cables directly to the front panel. Whether your cable ends in USB-C or USB-A, the connection point stays on the front of the station. Plug in the cable that matches your device and keep its route visible across the desk.
## Less Clutter. One Charging Station.
Replace separate charging adapters with one shared station and make cable routing easier to organize. A shared station reduces the number of individual charging adapters competing for space. Device cables still remain, but bringing their starting points together makes it easier to arrange shorter, more deliberate routes across your desk.
## Power for Your Laptop.
Use a compatible high-power USB-C port and cable to charge your laptop at your desk. Make the laptop part of your central charging setup instead of treating it as a separate power task. Choose a compatible port, protocol and cable; actual charging power will depend on the laptop, battery state and supported configuration.
## The Right Port for Each Device.
Connect compatible laptops to the high-power USB-C ports, with suitable ports for tablets, phones and everyday accessories—all in one desktop setup.
Port ratings indicate maximum supported output. Actual charging power varies by device, cable and charging conditions.
## Snap On. Power Up.
A dedicated magnetic charging spot gives your compatible Apple Watch a place to recharge alongside your other devices. Give your watch a dedicated place beside the devices you already charge at your desk. Bring it to the magnetic charging spot, let it settle into contact, and check the watch’s charging indication before leaving it to recharge.
## Protection Built In.
Built-in charging safeguards help protect your connected devices, so you can stay focused on work, play and everything in between.
## Powered by GaN Technology.
A GaN-based power design brings high-power charging into a compact desktop station, ready for your everyday devices.
## Touch to Change the Mood.
Touch the sun icon to cycle through the available light colors. The lighting control is part of the station itself. Use the sun-marked touch area to move between the available colors and choose the look that suits your desk at that moment.
## Five Colors. Your Style.
One distinctive design. Five different finishes. Choose the look that fits your desk and makes it yours.
## One Station. Every Part of Your Day.
From focused workdays to gaming nights, bring your everyday devices together in one charging setup. Keep compatible laptops, tablets, phones and accessories powered from a central station, with fewer separate adapters and connections that are easier to organize—at the office, at home or in your creative workspace.
## Know Your Charging Station.
Measuring just 55 × 95 × 111 mm with the base, the upright design brings multi-device charging into a compact desktop footprint, leaving more room for work and play.
## Stay Grounded. Charge On.
The non-slip base helps keep your charging station steady during everyday use. With a finish that matches the station, it brings added stability and a coordinated look to your desk.
## Choose Your Setup.
Find the right set for your desk—from the Standard Set to the Plus and Complete Sets. Add cable clips, extra charging cables or a matching non-slip base to make the setup your own.
## From Sketch to Reality.
Through sketches, 3D models and physical prototypes, we refine the proportions, details and port layout—shaping Your Power Armory for everyday use on your desk.
## The People Behind Your Power Armory.
At QITUO LABS, we bring industrial design, mechanical engineering and quality testing together. Working with our manufacturing partners, we turn design details into practical production steps—bringing Your Power Armory closer to your desk.
risks: AMPORY is already at the working prototype stage, but bringing a 660W high-power charging product into mass production still involves several important challenges. The main risks include final safety and compliance testing, thermal performance under sustained high loads, component supply, production consistency, and possible delays during mass manufacturing or international shipping. To reduce these risks, we are working with experienced manufacturing partners, validating the final hardware through functional and aging tests, and refining quality-control procedures before mass production. We will also complete the required compliance and certification processes for the markets we plan to ship to. Because AMPORY supports multiple ports and dynamic power allocation, final output may vary depending on connected devices, charging protocols, cables, and port combinations. We will provide clear specifications and power-allocation information before shipping. If unexpected production or logistics issues occur, we will communicate progress openly with our backers and adjust the delivery schedule when necessary. Our goal is not simply to ship quickly, but to deliver a stable, safe, and reliable product.

faq.a: 660W refers to the maximum total output capacity of the charging station. Actual output depends on the connected devices, port combination, supported charging protocols, cables, and charging conditions.

faq.q: 2. Can AMPORY charge 10 devices at the same time?
faq.a:
Yes. AMPORY features 6 USB-C ports and 4 USB-A ports, allowing up to 10 wired devices to be connected at the same time.

Power is distributed across the ports according to the connected devices and the active port combination.

No. The highest-power USB-C ports support up to 140W individually. Other USB-C ports have different maximum output levels.

Please refer to the port labels and final power-allocation chart for detailed specifications.

faq.q: 4. Can I charge two laptops at the same time?
faq.a:
Yes. AMPORY is designed to support multi-device desktop charging, including multiple laptops.

Actual charging power for each laptop will depend on the ports used, the devices, cables, and the total power being shared across the station.

faq.q: 5. Does AMPORY charge Apple Watch directly?
faq.a:
AMPORY includes a dedicated magnetic charging position for Apple Watch on the rear of the charging station.

Final compatibility information and supported Apple Watch models will be listed in the campaign specifications.

faq.q: 6. What is included with the standard AMPORY reward?
faq.a:
The standard reward includes:

1 × AMPORY 660W Desktop Charging Station
1 × AC Power Cord

Any additional USB-C cables, Desk Dock, Tech Pouch, or cable-management accessories will be clearly listed in the corresponding reward tier or add-on.

faq.q: 7. Can I choose the color of my AMPORY?
faq.a:
Yes. AMPORY will be available in multiple color options.

Backers will be asked to select their preferred color through the post-campaign survey before production is finalized.

faq.q: 8. Do I need a special USB-C cable for 140W charging?
faq.a:
Yes. To achieve high-power USB-C charging, you need a compatible USB-C cable that supports the required power level and charging protocol.

For best performance, we recommend using a suitable high-power E-Marker USB-C cable.

faq.q: 9. What safety certifications will AMPORY have?
faq.a:
AMPORY is being prepared for the safety, EMC, and regulatory requirements of the markets we plan to ship to.

Final certification names, compliance marks, and applicable regions will be published once the corresponding testing and certification processes are completed.

According to our current project schedule, mass production, quality inspection, and packaging are planned after the crowdfunding campaign, with shipping expected to begin in January 2027.

We will keep backers informed if production, certification, or logistics conditions require any schedule adjustments.

## 295% Funded — Thank You to Our First 103 Backers! ⚡
Hi everyone,
AMPORY has surpassed its funding goal! With $8,864 pledged by 103 backers, we’ve reached 295% of our original target.
To everyone who backed us, shared the project, or asked a thoughtful question: thank you. Your early support means a great deal to our team.
Reaching this milestone is an exciting beginning. Our focus remains on delivering AMPORY, communicating clearly, and keeping you informed as the project moves forward. We’ll share progress, next steps, and any changes to our plans through campaign updates.
